Destroy [[The Greater Darkness]]'s Deathbringer Company to lure the [[demon]] out.

==Quest Information==
===Objectives===
* Destroy the Deathbringer Company 
* See [[Voice of Whispers]] for your reward. 

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[XP]]
* 800 [[Gold]]
* 800 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]

==Walkthrough==
This is a relatively easy quest. The Deathbringer Company is a group of eight [[Torment creature]]s; one of each [[profession]] (except for the 2 monks). Defeat that group to complete the quest. They are located west of the rift (from the preceding quest).

When the quest reward is accepted, the Greater Darkness will spawn nearby. See the quest information in [[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)#The Greater Darkness|Mallyx the Unyielding]] for strategies in defeating it.
